$comment: Types read by hand from the Claude Code 2.1.308 program for the status line input fields that tools/schemas/code.ts leaves x-unverified.

scratchpad_dir.note: Function ku (the shared hook and status line base input) sets scratchpad_dir:bC()?TT(e.id)??void 0:void 0. TT builds the path with node path.join (ve(MA(),e,"scratchpad")) or returns null; ?? void 0 turns null into undefined, which JSON drops. So a string when present.

agent_type.note: ku sets agent_type:h with h=s?.agentType??qk(). qk() returns the main thread agent type from the hook registry, a string agent type name (undefined when none, which JSON drops).

cost.total_cost_usd.note: ZUr builds cost:{total_cost_usd:Rh(),...!1,total_duration_ms:fSe(),total_api_duration_ms:yF(),total_lines_added:RNe(),total_lines_removed:xNe()}. Each reads the cost ledger class (totalCostUSD, totalDuration, totalAPIDuration, totalLinesAdded, totalLinesRemoved). totalCostUSD() returns #e, a running sum (#e+=e in recordCost) that starts at 0, so a number (a float: US dollars).

cost.total_duration_ms.note: ZUr builds cost:{total_cost_usd:Rh(),...!1,total_duration_ms:fSe(),total_api_duration_ms:yF(),total_lines_added:RNe(),total_lines_removed:xNe()}. Each reads the cost ledger class (totalCostUSD, totalDuration, totalAPIDuration, totalLinesAdded, totalLinesRemoved). totalDuration() returns Math.max(0,Date.now()-#r): a number of milliseconds.

cost.total_api_duration_ms.note: ZUr builds cost:{total_cost_usd:Rh(),...!1,total_duration_ms:fSe(),total_api_duration_ms:yF(),total_lines_added:RNe(),total_lines_removed:xNe()}. Each reads the cost ledger class (totalCostUSD, totalDuration, totalAPIDuration, totalLinesAdded, totalLinesRemoved). totalAPIDuration() returns #t, a running sum of the durations passed to recordApiDuration (#t+=e), starting at 0: a number of milliseconds.

cost.total_lines_added.note: ZUr builds cost:{total_cost_usd:Rh(),...!1,total_duration_ms:fSe(),total_api_duration_ms:yF(),total_lines_added:RNe(),total_lines_removed:xNe()}. Each reads the cost ledger class (totalCostUSD, totalDuration, totalAPIDuration, totalLinesAdded, totalLinesRemoved). totalLinesAdded() returns #i, a running count (#i+=e in recordLinesChanged), starting at 0: a number.

cost.total_lines_removed.note: ZUr builds cost:{total_cost_usd:Rh(),...!1,total_duration_ms:fSe(),total_api_duration_ms:yF(),total_lines_added:RNe(),total_lines_removed:xNe()}. Each reads the cost ledger class (totalCostUSD, totalDuration, totalAPIDuration, totalLinesAdded, totalLinesRemoved). totalLinesRemoved() returns #l, a running count (#l+=t in recordLinesChanged), starting at 0: a number.

exceeds_200k_tokens.note: ZUr takes exceeds200kTokens:r. Its caller passes s=this.#f=jEe(messages). jEe returns !1 or iO(usage)>200000, a boolean.

fast_mode.note: ZUr takes fastMode:s from the app state field fastMode, which starts as fastMode:!1 and is only set to !1 or a boolean (Y((h)=>({...h,fastMode:!1}))).

remote.session_id.note: ...Zn()!==null&&{remote:{session_id:e.id}}: e is the session object; its id is the session id string (V() / randomUUID).
